notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
OpenVAS (Greenbone Vulnerability Manager) is an open-source vulnerability scanner. Setup involves: installing GVM packages, running gvm-setup (downloads NVT feed ~100k checks), creating admin account, starting services. Initial feed download can take 30+ minutes.

=== CHAINING ===
Setup → gvm-start → web UI (port 9392) → create scan target → create scan task → run → export report → prioritize by CVSS/NVT severity → recommend remediation.

=== vs NESSUS ===
OpenVAS is free and open-source with a large NVT (Network Vulnerability Test) database. Nessus has a more polished UI and more compliance checks. Both generate similar output; choice depends on budget and organizational preference.
